program.name: Hip Opening Long
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Long yoga practices that open the hips, the hamstrings and the spine in turn.
program.about: Long practices for tight hips and legs. One day works through lunges, pigeon and lizard shapes; the next the hamstrings with folds and splits; the third twists, standing and seated. Each closes with a long rest. Three days rotate. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
